# Target

> > America's leading omnichannel retailer offering groceries, apparel, electronics, and home goods with Same Day Delivery, Order Pickup, and exclusive Target brands.

Target operates 1,800+ stores across the United States and provides comprehensive shopping experiences through Target.com, Target Circle loyalty programs, and services like Target Circle 360. The company offers career opportunities across retail stores, supply chain, corporate offices, and its retail media division Roundel.

## Key Topics

- Target Circle
- Target Circle Card
- Target Circle 360
- Same Day Delivery
- Order Pickup
- Target Brands
- TargetPlus

- [Help : Target](https://www.target.com/help): Target help center with FAQs on orders, returns, Circle Card & recalls
- [Contact Us : Target](https://www.target.com/help/contact-us): Contact Target via phone or chat for Circle Card, orders & gift cards
